d: Long, spiky platinum white hair with choppy bangs and two large tufts protruding from the top of the head, paired with sharp, narrow crimson eyes. The face is that of a mature young adult with a curvy, voluptuous build. The outfit consists of a white wrap-around chest top, a short red pleated skirt with a dark brown belt, and asymmetric legwear featuring one black stocking and one white bandage wrap, all accented by red and grey boots. Massive, grey industrial battleship rigging with multiple gun turrets and cannons is attached to the back.
